_meanings:
.²1 An iron (or wooden) beam or bar used for locking or shutting a gate
 ({#argala#}); {#ekaH kftsnAM nagarapariGaprAMSubAhurBunakti#} <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>;
 <ls>R. 16. 84</ls>; <ls>Śi. 19. 32</ls>; <ls>M. 5. 2</ls>.
.²2 (Hence) A bar, barrier, hindrance, obstacle; {#BArgavasya sukfto'pi#}
 {#so'Bavat svargamArgapariGo duratyayaH#} <ls>R. 11. 88</ls>.
.²3 A stick or club studded or tipped with iron; {#pAdapAvidDapariGaH#} <ls>R. 12. 73</ls>.
.²4 An iron club in general. It is a kind of weapon ({#parito hantItI--sarvataH#}

 {#kaRwakito lohadaRqaH#} <ab>com.</ab> on <ls>Mb. 1. 19. 17</ls>); {#… … hantuM GoraM#}
 {#pariGamAdade#} <ls>Śiva B. 14. 99</ls>.
.²5 A water-jar, pitcher.
.²6 A glass-pitcher.
.²7 A house, dwelling.
.²8 Killing, destroying.
.²9 Striking, a stroke or blow.
.²10 A child which assumes a peculiar cross position in birth.
.²11 A line of clouds crossing the sun at sunrise or sunset.
.²12 The gate of a palace, town or house. Hence perhaps it means ‘Gate-duty’;
 {#mUlaM BAgo vyAjI pariGaH kxptaM rUpikamatyayaScAya-muKam#} <ls>Kau. A. 2. 6. 24</ls>.
.²13 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the 19th Yoga.

(<ab>du.</ab>) Two birds flying on each side of a traveller
 (regarded as an omen).
as heavy as an iron bar; <ls>M.</ls>
